message.content:
In the verilator/ subtree of this repo (/home/nick/work/hybrid_sim/verilator), I need to know exactly what cycle/mcycle figure vsim prints when it is run as a plain end-to-end simulation (the "cycle model": no --hybrid-icount, no handoff, just `sim_<cpu> <elf>`).

Specifically answer:
1. Where in the vsim C++/SystemC source is the cycle or mcycle count printed to stdout at the end of a run? Give file:line and the exact format string.
2. Does that printed number represent the WHOLE-PROGRAM total mcycle (from reset to program exit), or is it a marker-delimited ROI / window subset? 
3. Does vsim, in plain passthrough mode (no hybrid flags), pay any attention to the ROI marker instructions (slti x0,x0,0x5A0 / 0x5A1) — e.g. does it reset or sample mcycle at those markers? Or are markers completely ignored unless a --hybrid flag is passed?
4. Is there any "mcycle delta" or "window" reporting in the plain cycle-model path, or only a single total?

Be thorough: grep for mcycle, "cycle", printf/cout/fprintf of cycle counts, ROI, marker, 0x5A0, slti. Report file:line evidence for each claim. Do not modify anything.
